name: mishpat
description: Governance — proposals, challenges, gate-decisions, deliberation. Validators of community decisions.

attestation:governance-role.description: Declares a subject holds a specific governance role within a scope. New subtype (previously implicit in challenge / proposal flows).

attestation:gate-decision.description: Records a gate's decision on a subject (allow / block / pending). Replaces GateDecisionAttestation entry type.

attestation:proposal-vote.description: Vote on a governance proposal. Replaces ProposalVote entry type. Vote-child of governance-action:proposal.

attestation:statement-vote.description: Polis-style agree/disagree/pass vote on an OpinionStatement. Replaces StatementVote entry type. (OpinionStatement itself moves to the observation layer per spec §6.4.)

attestation:governance-reaction.description: Lightweight reaction (support / concern / question / amendment-suggested) to a governance artifact. Replaces GovernanceReaction entry type.

attestation:forget-decision.description: Mishpat-issued decision on a forget-request signal. Records outcome of right-to-be-forgotten governance request. See observation-event-layer spec §9.4.

governance-action:proposal.description: Generic governance proposal voted on by qahal members. Replaces Proposal entry type.

governance-action:challenge.description: Challenge against a governance decision or gate. Replaces Challenge + GateDecisionChallenge entry types.

governance-action:election.description: Election of a governance role. New capability (previously not modeled).
